Prompts

```
['create an MCPApp instance that connects to an MCP server via stdio using a server command', 'create an MCPApp instance that connects to an MCP server via SSE using a server URL', 'call a tool on the connected MCP server by name with keyword arguments', 'list all available resources from the MCP server with their descriptions and arguments', 'read a resource from the MCP server by its URI and return its content']
```

Usage

```
{'connect_mcp_app_stdio': 'create an MCPApp instance that connects to an MCP server via stdio using a server command', 'connect_mcp_app_sse': 'create an MCPApp instance that connects to an MCP server via SSE using a server URL', 'call_mcp_tool': 'call a tool on the connected MCP server by name with keyword arguments', 'list_mcp_resources': 'list all available resources from the MCP server with their descriptions and arguments', 'read_mcp_resource': 'read a resource from the MCP server by its URI and return its content'}
```
